result.answer: This is an auto insurance policy for a vehicle. It specifies deductibles (Own Damage ₹2,000; Theft ₹5,000; Natural Calamity ₹2,000), a No Claim Bonus (NCB) structure (Current NCB 20%; Next Year 25% if no claims; Maximum 50% after five claim-free years), renewal terms (Policy is renewable annually with a 90-day grace period), and conditions such as inspection for vehicles over five years and declaration of modifications. It also provides emergency contacts and an authorized dealer (Honda Authorized Service Center) information.

sources.source_text:
DEDUCTIBLES:
- Own Damage Claims: ₹2,000 (compulsory deductible)
- Theft Claims: ₹5,000
- Natural Calamity Claims: ₹2,000

NO CLAIM BONUS:
- Current NCB: 20% (2 years claim-free)
- Next Year NCB: 25% (if no claims this year)
- Maximum NCB: 50% (after 5 claim-free years)

IMPORTANT TERMS:
- Policy is renewable annually
- Grace period for renewal: 90 days
- Inspection required for vehicles over 5 years
- Modifications to vehicle must be declared

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- 24x7 Claim Helpline: 1800-209-5858
- Roadside Assistance: 1800-209-5959
- Customer Care: care@bajajallianz.co.in

AUTHORIZED DEALER:
- Service Center: Honda Authorized Service Center
- Address: Sector 18, Noida, UP
- Contact: 0120-4567890
